limits: The real saved neural waveform is replayed through fixture chat/package envelopes; no live inference service is involved.
Lip motion uses actual analyser amplitude; no phoneme alignment or acoustic output latency was measured.
Gesture cues are authored test fixtures, not a learned contextual or personal gesture policy.
Rendered-frame clock gaps passed the unchanged750ms functional gate; this is not a lip-sync quality acceptance or physical-device performance benchmark.
Observed frame counts belong to the two CI cases with different layouts; they are not a controlled FPS comparison.
Screenshots are taken after Stop to avoid affecting timed playback; exact frame traces preserve the actual composed outputs during playback.
First and intermediate failed attempts remain preserved separately; no threshold was widened to obtain this pass.
